item.title: Self-Hosted Email Sieve Filtering: Pigeonhole vs Rspamd Sieve vs Cyrus Sieve
item.description: Email filtering is a critical component of any self-hosted mail infrastructure. While spam filters like Rspamd and SpamAssassin handle the initial wave of unwanted messages, the Sieve filtering language provides a standardized, server-side mechanism for organizing, tagging, redirecting, and manipulating email after delivery. Sieve scripts run on the IMAP/LDA server, enabling users to create sophisticated rules for sorting newsletters into folders, auto-forwarding critical messages, rejecting specific senders, and much more — all without relying on client-side filtering.
